name: Weifan Mao

papers.title: LSPR: Init-Anchored Score-Based Multi-Camera Calibration for Indoor Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multi-camera perception is a load-bearing pillar of indoor robot manipulation, yet current feed-forward 3D foundation models still provide only centimeter-level camera poses on cluttered manipulation rigs. In our RH20T setting, off-the-shelf COLMAP and RGB-D ICP can degrade rather than reliably improve WorldMirror-v2 initializations. We present latent score-based pose refinement (LSPR), a foundation-init-conditioned calibration method that repurposes diffusion from global pose generation into local residual refinement on the $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ tangent space. LSPR learns the score field of the residual pose-error distribution induced by a strong initializer: ground-truth rigs are corrupted by tangent-space perturbations covering the initializer's small-noise regime, and inference follows this field from the foundation initialization rather than sampling poses from noise. To make this local refinement reliable, LSPR combines score-level ensembling, hard-tier sample mining, and a confidence gate that falls back to the initializer under distribution shift. On held-out RH20T manipulation scenes, LSPR improves WorldMirror-v2 initializations from centimeter-level to sub-centimeter, sub-degree $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$-aligned accuracy, and these calibration gains transfer to downstream multi-view depth fusion.
